parole.significato: to rub, to scratch (an itch) (bodyparts in general)
parole.testo: * From *kroj, from Proto-Albanian *krābnja, from Proto-Indo-European *gʰrebʰ-. Compare German graben (“to dig”), Lithuanian grebti (“to rake”) * Alternatively from Proto-Albanian *krawånj-, from Old High German krauwōn. * Or from North-West IE *kna-ye- ‘scratch’, cf. Welsh cnoi, Old High German nōen

From Serbo-Croatian pehar (“cup”), from Old High German pehhari (compare German Becher), from Late Latin pīcārium (variant of bīcārium), possibly from bacarium, or from Ancient Greek βίκος (bíkos). Compare also German Becher, Italian bicchiere, English pitcher and beaker.
